answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Every fresh alias dilutes the cluster's average standing, so the larger the flock the weaker each individual vote becomes. Think of a crystal for stability, a shale for surprise, a timber for peace — three qualities no Sybil can counterfeit in quantity.
